title: claude-neoize structural graph
description: The output shape a project collector (.neoize/collect.py) writes to .neoize/graph.json. It is a projection of the code, regenerated and never hand-edited. The sibling .neoize/graph.cypher is the MERGE form loaded into Neo4j; keep both in sync. ONE shared Neo4j serves many products, so graph.json stays product-agnostic (ids are local to the product); graph.cypher must carry the product discriminant in EVERY node key: MERGE on `{product:$product, id:...}`, never `{id:...}` alone, with the loader binding $product to this project's product. A key without product would merge two products' same-id nodes into one and would survive the product-scoped structural reset as an orphan, so `neoize load-graph` refuses a .cypher that does not mention `product`.

label.description: The node label, a domain entity kind (Module, Service, Route, Entity, ...). Chosen for THIS project, not generic.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the label. A lesson anchors to {type: label, id: id}.

props.description: Flat scalar properties (Neo4j has no nested node maps).

type.description: Relationship type, a verb the project reasons along (DEPENDS_ON, IMPLEMENTS, GRANTS, CALLS, ...).

counts.description: Optional node/edge counts the collector prints; informational.
